description: Closeup of Georgia O'Keeffe in the raft smiling dressed in a long sleeve jacket, river and rock face in background. This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe Smiling in the Raft
